claim_verdicts.claim_text: The chart documents a penicillin allergy that is severe, with anaphylaxis to amoxicillin in 2019 that required epinephrine.

citations.quote: Entry 1 | Allergen: penicillins (reaction occurred with amoxicillin) | Type: allergy | Severity: severe
Entry 1 | Reaction: anaphylaxis (generalized hives, throat tightness, hypotension) | Onset: 2019-05 | Treated in an emergency department with intramuscular epinephrine

claim_verdicts.why: The allergy list entry records a severe penicillin allergy with the reaction occurring with amoxicillin, and the entry documents anaphylaxis from 2019-05 treated with intramuscular epinephrine. The claim accurately reports what the chart documents.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: The full answer notes a conflicting triage NKDA entry elsewhere in the chart; this claim only reports what the allergy list documents, so the conflict does not make it false, though the claim does not acknowledge it.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The penicillin allergy is corroborated by the 2024 clinic note.
